name: 鹿鼎天下 (in-game: 雄霸天下『西安站』)
group_note: Century/adm-single family (shiji/shujian2008/xjcq2000/xkxz2/xiakexing100), in-game titled 雄霸天下『西安站』. WASM pass: gutted adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc's startup_udp()/send_udp()/socket_close() call in send_shutdown() (§7.52 socket-daemon gutting) -- socket_create()/socket_bind() are undefined efuns under this WASM build, and the resulting failed compile broke every call_other() into the file mid-function, including the encoding_to_mudlist() step that runs before the id prompt on every single connection. No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs (is_chinese() already codepoint-correct). Admin account 'fluffos'/'Mud@2026' was already seeded in adm/etc/wizlist from an earlier, pre-WASM pass over this lib (this lib already has a live deployment referenced in its README) -- verified the existing credentials still log in and show (admin) correctly, no new account needed (initially misread this as the §1.5 bootstrap-id-collision pattern and added a redundant parallel 'fladmin' account before noticing the lib's own pre-existing README already documented working fluffos credentials; reverted that addition). One pre-existing, non-blocking content gap left unfixed: d/city/npc/xiaobao.lpc's create() references a nonexistent /u/rhxlwd/cloth.lpc (a wizard directory that doesn't exist anywhere in this archive) -- call_other() on the resulting 0 throws 'Bad argument 1 to EFUN call_other()' but it's caught by the room's own setup()/reset() wrapper, so it never reaches the player; left as-is per the don't-fabricate-content precedent (same class as ffxymud/jhfy2/jhfy3's d/city/sj.lpc). Full registration (gb encoding select -> id -> confirm -> Chinese name -> password -> confirm -> gift select '0' -> accept 'y' -> email -> gender) and look->score->quit verified end-to-end before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter introduced no corruption (all 3 blind-spot checks clean).
